info.description: The /api/v1 REST mirror of the 3ngram memory core (docs/concepts/architecture.mdx: one core, N transports). Authenticate with an X-API-Key header or a session Bearer token.
info.title: 3ngram REST API

delete.summary: Self-serve account deletion: erase PII in place and revoke credentials (GDPR Art. 17 erasure)

schema.description: Comma-separated subset of sections to compute (unique names from: commitments, overdue, blockers, staleCandidates, recentDecisions, preferences). Absent = all sections; un-requested sections are skipped and omitted from the result.
Per-section item bound (1..100). Absent = the mode default (3 brief / 25 full).

get.summary: Session briefing over an explicit selector (mirrors the MCP briefing tool)
The caller's current budget status (effective cap + spend this cycle)

post.summary: Dashboard search continuation with identity-only hits

get.summary: Download the caller's complete data archive (GDPR Art. 20 portability)
Currently-valid facts, with optional bi-temporal time travel (mirrors the MCP get_facts tool)

schema.description: Single memory type to match. Mutually exclusive with memoryTypes — pass one or the other, never both.
OR-set of memory types to match (repeat the param to pass several). Mutually exclusive with type — pass one or the other, never both.

get.summary: List memories (bounded; identity fields only, never content)

409.description: The content is already live or the live-memory resource limit has been reached

post.summary: Append a new memory (mirrors the MCP remember tool)

get.summary: Distinct scope and project values for the tenant (filter population)
Inspect a single memory, including content

post.summary: Archive an active memory (REST-only lifecycle operation; no MCP mirror)

get.summary: Inspect memory lineage, direct relationships, and audit metadata

post.summary: Transition the commitment riding a memory (mirrors the MCP resolve tool)
Supersede a memory with a corrected successor (mirrors the MCP revise tool)

get.summary: List the tenant's registered scope names

post.summary: Unified semantic + keyword retrieval (mirrors the MCP search tool)

get.summary: Bounded count aggregates (counts only, never content)
